newsitem.title: UK: Intertanko starts moves to build Asian membership.
newsitem.headline: Intertanko starts moves to build Asian membership.

text.p: The International Association of Independent Tanker Owners (Intertanko) will inaugurate moves to strengthen its involvement in Asian markets from May.
Intertanko said it will hold the first meeting of its new Asia Regional Panel in Singapore on May 13, 1997.
It said: "The overall aim of the new regional panel is to boost the participation of Asia's tanker shipping interests in the activities of the association."
The initiative will address tanker issues particular to the Asian region and discuss matters of common interest, Intertanko added.
Intertanko, whose current membership represents 70 percent of independently owned tanker tonnage worldwide, also said it hoped the move would increase its membership in the region.
It said it has organised tanker chartering and media training courses for May 14 and 15 to coincide with the inaugural session of the Asia panel.
